messages:
laura: Quick heads-up — found vulns in our base layers during nightly scan, needs a small rebuild + signer/KMS alignment. Affects `runtime-base:v2026-03-10` and `tools-builder:latest`. Who's owning RBAC for the signer and keystore?

sam: Ugh. Which CVEs exactly? can you paste the scanner output? :grimacing: 

laura: scanner shows libcrypto/libssl CVE-2026-0456 + a minor zlib path issue. attaching excerpt: `scanner: vuln libssl 2.0.1 -> CVE-2026-0456; paths: /usr/lib/libcrypto.so` 

mei: Thanks. For signer/KMS: we should *not* use cluster-admin. Plan: create a dedicated `image-signer` SA with only `cloudkms.cryptoSign` and read access to the keystore secret. Drop any existing broad rolebindings. Also rotate the cosign key envelope in KMS before signing. Audit retention: bump to 90 days for this rebuild window.

arun: Can do the RBAC change. I'll prepare a kustomize overlay that scopes the SA to `kube-system/signing` namespace and opens only the needed bindings. ETA PR in ~2 hours. We should also ensure the signing job runs in a sealed network egress policy.

sam: I'll open the infra PR to change bindings + add a workflow that calls KMS envelope-unwrap then cosign sign. Will include: `kubectl auth can-i` checks and CI smoke. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3987 (wip)

laura: Also need runtime runtime-team to schedule the base image rebuild canary. Prefer small-batch canary to staging first. Can we do a 10% pool in staging then expand? 

arun: yes — small-batch staging canary. I'll coordinate with deploy-bot to lock window.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled image rebuild canary for `runtime-base:v2026-03-10` at 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z, target subset clusters: staging-[a,b], notify @laura @sam @mei.

mei: For audit logs: ensure KMS access events are forwarded to our long-term audit sink and mark the rebuild run with `rebuild=2026-03-25` tag so we can filter. Also collect SBOMs and push to attestation store before signing.

sam: Noted. I'll add SBOM generation to the build job and upload to GCS path `gs://redwood-artifacts/rebuilds/2026-03-25/`. Also will attach `cosign` signatures once KMS envelope rotated.

laura: OK — owners: RBAC/keystore = @arun, infra signing flow + CI = @sam, vuln triage & audit policy = @mei. Action items: 1) @arun open RBAC PR (link here). 2) @sam finalize infra PR + SBOM. 3) @mei confirm audit sink + retention. 4) I'll schedule the canary and send postmortem template. Anything missing?

mei: please add an incident channel for the rebuild in case we see regressions: `#incidents/runtime-image-rebuild-2026-03-25`. I'll pin runbook snippet once channel exists.

laura: done — created channel and added runbook stub. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3987 ready for review, includes rolebinding diff and cosign workflow snippet. 

arun: RBAC PR drafted, will ping for review in 30m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary build started for `runtime-base:v2026-03-10-rebuild-2026-03-25` on staging-a at 2026-03-25T02:01:12Z

laura: i'll monitor logs and escalate to incidents if anything odd. good work folks.
